message.content:
I don’t have access to live data feeds, so I can’t tell you the exact Air Quality Index (AQI) for Los Angeles at this moment. However, you can quickly check the current conditions on several reliable platforms:

| Source | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **AirNow.gov** | Search “Los Angeles” → choose your ZIP code or city → view the latest AQI and pollutant breakdown. |
| **EPA’s Air Quality Dashboard** | Navigate to the “Live Data” section → select California → pick Los Angeles County. |
| **OpenAQ API** | If you’re comfortable with APIs, query `https://api.openaq.org/v2/latest?city=Los%20Angeles` to get recent measurements. |
| **Weather apps** | Most weather services (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or smartphone weather widgets) display an AQI indicator for major cities. |

If you’d like me to fetch the most recent AQI from one of those public APIs (for example, using the OpenAQ endpoint), just let me know which source you prefer and I’ll retrieve it for you.
